title: Core: z-order operations (bring to front/back/forward/backward)
description: Implement z-order operations in packages/core/src/engine/zorder.ts. Functions: bringToFront(doc, sceneIdx, layerIdx, frameIdx, objectId), sendToBack(...), bringForward(...), sendBackward(...). In Flash 8, display object order within a keyframe.displayObjects array determines z-order (last = on top). These operations reorder the array. All immutable. Export from engine/index.ts. Add unit tests.
